name: loco4coco
description: Loco for CoCo - a sub-five-minute booth activation for Snowflake World Tour. A visitor drives a penguin round an arctic map, answers a few light questions, and leaves with a POC blueprint: their idea in their own words, the Snowflake developer guide to fork, the features it uses with doc links, and a ready-to-paste Cortex Code kick-off prompt for their free trial. It runs as a local Python server plus a browser canvas (game/); the shared closed lists live in Snowflake and, offline, in skills/loco4coco/references/. Visitor-facing copy is externalised into game/config.json so Paris is a translation, not a rebuild. No dependency on other plugins.

context.note: The definitive closed lists the activation may name: Marketplace listings, developer guides, feature doc links, POC archetypes and integration routes. Declared here so they are retrievable without a running booth server and without MCP, which is not guaranteed on a borrowed laptop.
context.retrieval: Deterministic keyword scoring in game/context.py, NOT a search service. The corpus is ~150 rows, so scoring it in process is instant, offline-safe and repeatable - which a Snowflake-branded stand requires. Entry points: resolve_archetype(text) routes a visitor's own words to one of nine POC shapes via the archetype pain text; shortlist_block(text, industry) returns a prompt-ready block of only the listings, features and guides that turn may use.
context.reaches_cortex_exec_by: Prompt injection of the shortlist, not tool access. `cortex exec` cannot be given tools except through MCP, and the shortlist is ~220 tokens, so the model is handed the candidates instead of being asked to search for them.

sources.why: Current and shareable. How another SE's laptop, or Paris, gets the same lists without pulling a git branch. CONTEXT_MANIFEST holds a SHA-256 per source file so any laptop can prove parity.
Committed on purpose. The offline path, and committing it means drift from the markdown shows up in review rather than silently on the stand. Do not hand-edit.
The human-editable source of truth and the last resort. Edit these, then regenerate the bundle and run deploy/load_context.py.

rules: A feature absent from feature-docs.md is DROPPED rather than rendered without a link. Omitting one beats shipping a guess in something a visitor keeps.
Only listings in marketplace-index.md may ever be named.
All curated listings are free to acquire; 11 of 48 are time-limited trials rather than perpetual Free. Nothing Paid ships.
Every layer returning the same counts is asserted by the parity check. A mismatch means the bundle or the tables are stale.
